item.description: Mr. Jarange-Patil has set an August 29 deadline and threatened a fresh “final” agitation over delays and denials in the certificate process

item.title: NHRC seeks report on deaths in Assam factory explosion
item.description: Five people, including the owner of the factory, were arrested in connection with the explosion, which left two other workers severely injured

item.description: President Droupadi Murmu congratulates Gulveer Singh and Harjinder Kaur for snagging silver medals at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow

item.title: More rains predicted in Delhi, IMD issues yellow alert
item.description: The IMD has forecast a generally cloudy sky with light to moderate rainfall at different hours of the day at isolated places across the city

item.title: Seafarers’ safety ‘highest priority’, says Indian Embassy in Ukraine amid attacks on ships in Black Sea
item.description: Fifteen sailors, including 13 Indians, are trapped in a “terrible and life-threatening situation” at the Ukrainian port of Chornomorsk in the Black Sea, FSUI said on July 28

item.title: FIR lodged over death of PhD scholar in Punjab; university offers ₹16 lakh aid, job to family member
item.description: The student’s death due to electrocution has sparked protests at the Panjab University campus

item.description: The former RBI Governor was delivering a special lecture commemorating the 35th anniversary of India’s New Economic Policy, organised by the PG and Research Department of Economics, Stella Maris College

item.title: SBSP chief Rajbhar targets Akhilesh through ‘Yadav’ plank
item.description: Akhilesh Yadav Ji, in every village, your party is known as a party of goons and mafia. This is 100% true. When in power, you bring a complete package of ‘jungle raj.’ Non-Yadav backward classes and Bahujans openly face, says (SBSP president Om Prakash Rajbhar

item.title: Telangana unlikely to face drinking water shortage; major reservoirs hold sufficient water for domestic needs

item.title: Rockfall near Munnar Headworks Dam in Kerala disrupts traffic on Kochi-Dhanushkodi NH
item.description: Since there were no vehicles on the route at the time, a major tragedy was averted, say officials

item.title: West Bengal CM launches helpline numbers to tackle corruption
item.description: State Chief Secretary Manoj Agrawal said that all calls to the toll-free number will be recorded and there will be a mechanism to retrieve the records if necessary.

item.title: Global Tiger Day: Proud to say India is home to 70% of its global population, says PM Modi
item.description: The International Tiger Day is celebrated on July 29 every year to raise global awareness to the conservation of tigers

item.title: Maharashtra police flags ‘cross-border disinformation’ campaign on NEET protests
item.description: Anti-social elements from from Pakistan and Middle Eastern countries were amplifying misleading narratives, says cyber cell

item.title: TCS harassment case: AIMIM corporator arrested in Nashik
item.description: Mateen Patel was taken into custody, months after police tracked down accused Nida Khan to a house arranged by him in the Marathwada city

item.title: Kerala Health Dept steps up vigil in Kanhangad after woman dies from H1N1
item.description: Health department has collected samples from seven persons who had been in close contact with the patient for testing. Their health condition is being monitored

item.title: Bengaluru’s ‘Freedom from Waste’ drive: C&D and inert waste to be cleared off streets from August 1
item.description: Bengaluru Solid Waste Management Ltd. has developed a dedicated app ‘Clearit’ for the purpose

item.title: Bengaluru: Revamped ORR to include dedicated bus, cycle lanes; space under flyovers to be repurposed

item.description: Victim claims he was struck on the head with a stone

item.title: GBA to impose penalty of up to ₹1 lakh for Bengaluru plot owners not clearing garbage by August 15
item.description: The GBA had asked empty plot owners to clean up their sites on July 15 and set a deadline of August 15, giving one month’s time.

item.title: Centre says no timeline for Namma Metro Red Line and approval depends on appraisal, resources
item.description: The proposed corridor will connect Hebbal in north Bengaluru with Sarjapur Road in the city’s southeastern IT corridor, traversing major commercial and residential hubs, including the Central Business District and Koramangala

item.title: BJP suspends 9 workers over ‘berating slogans’ during August 5 rally in Kashmir
Uttar Pradesh Jal Nigam ties up with IIM Indore, IIT Kanpur for rural water reforms
item.description: With IIT Kanpur and IIM Indore on board as knowledge partners, UPJN(R) is positioning itself to deliver safe drinking water and effective sewage treatment and disposal services to rural Uttar Pradesh with the standards of efficiency, transparency and reliability expected of a world-class public water utility, says Raj Shekhar, Managing Director of Uttar Pradesh Jal Nigam (Rural)

item.title: After arrest of 3 Kerala teachers, SIT expands probe to track drug rackets’ financial intermediaries
item.description: Money trail being tracked as digital evidence points to wider network of local intermediaries who were reportedly in touch with a multi-State drug racket for passive income

item.title: Sashastra Seema Bal reserves 50% constable posts for ex-Agniveers, caste quota to apply
item.description: Although recruitment to the Army does not include caste-based reservations, the SSB says the existing quota for various categories, including SCs, STs and OBCs, will be applicable

item.title: Giri Pradakshina jams Visakhapatnam roads till past midnight; four-hour gridlock at Venkojipalem
item.description: Stretches from Maddilapalem to Madhurawada stayed jammed for up to four hours as lakhs walked the 32-km route; at Venkojipalem, motorists switched off their engines and slept in their cars or watched reels on their phones

item.title: ‘We were mum on students’ stir’: U.P. RLD chief quits, flags corruption
item.description: Speaking to The Hindu in Lucknow, Mr. Rai, said the way RLD, a party known to take positions on issues of public interest stopped making interventions over core matters, forced to him to take the step of resigning from the position and the party

item.title: New sculpture of celebrated actor Uttam Kumar in Kolkata draws flak from artists
item.description: Artists in Bengal say the sculpture is not a work of art but an “insult” to the late actor

item.title: Chennai-based Anicut Capital to invest in 20 startups with ₹175-crore fund
item.description: This fund is set to focus on Pre-e to Series A investments across deep-tech, enterprise-tech, consumer, and financial services startups

item.title: BJP bids to stave off JSP, RJD challenge as campaigning ends for Bankipur byelection
item.description: Candidates make final push to secure the seat in Bihar vacated by BJP national president Nitin Nabin following his election to the Rajya Sabha in April

item.title: Ahead of proposed strike, Haryana Energy Minister Anil Vij says talks with employees underway
item.description: Referring to their second demand regarding smart meters, Mr. Vij said that no tenders have yet been floated for the project and that the proposal is still under process

item.title: State Highways expedites work on ₹24-crore high-level bridge across Then Pennar river in Tiruvannamalai
item.description: The new bridge will be funded under the Comprehensive Road Infrastructure Development Programme (CRIDP) 2024-25

item.title: 150 years of the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science
item.description: The IACS has cultivated a legacy of intellectual curiosity, scientific excellence, and national service that continues to inspire generations of researchers, Shekhar Mande writes

item.title: A.P. inks pact with AstraZeneca to set up Genomic Solutions Centre in Amaravati
item.description: The centre to use next-generation sequencing, AI, and genomic technologies to facilitate early cancer detection and recommend personalised treatment based on a patient's genetic profile; as part of project, AI-enabled X-ray systems to be installed in government hospitals to ensure proper diagnosis

item.title: Pleas in Supreme Court allege illegal detentions by Delhi and Bihar police
item.description: Volunteer who distributed food and water to protesters at Jantar Mantar and his friend allege that police seized their phones, blindfolded them and questioned them at an undisclosed location over the ‘source of funds’; law student held without arrest warrant still in Bihar police custody

item.title: Pen mightier than any weapon: Ex-MP Vijay Sankeshwar

item.title: Edappally-Aroor elevated highway project in Kochi put on hold
item.description: Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nithin Gadkari informs Hibi Eden, MP, that the current priority is to widen the rest of the Thiruvananthapuram-Kasaragod NH 66

item.title: Relief camps shut in Kerala’s Ernakulam as rain situation eases

item.title: Rajya Sabha MP moves Supreme Court against use of facial recognition technology at NEET protests

item.title: Residents of old age home steal the scene at fashion show for senior citizens in Kerala’s Thrissur

item.title: Kerala CPI(M)’s self-critical review document preludes an organisational rectification process in State unit starting in September 2026
item.description: Review of Left Democratic Front (LDF)’s Assembly election debacle in Kerala. CPI(M) notes that its messaging about transformational development did not resonate among the middle classes. The growing influence of caste- and religion-tinted identity politics causes an erosion of the party’s basic voters, namely ‘workers, agricultural workers and poor peasants’
